'''Oscar''' (Japanese: '''オスカー''' ''Oscar'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[Mewtwo — Prologue to Awakening]]''. He lives in the mountains with his granddaughter {{un|Anna}}.

When Anna fell while they were hiking in the mountains, he had his {{p|Stoutland}} rescue her in the nick of time. However, when Oscar was about to pull her back up, the three fell and things were about to get worse until {{OBP|Mewtwo|M16}} arrived and {{m|Psychic|lifted}} them back up. It then flew off. When [[Virgil]] arrived at their home, making an emergency landing with his helicopter, Oscar told him the story about Mewtwo.

Later, he, Anna, Virgil and a mysterious man named [[Dirk]], who had also encountered Mewtwo, went to the mountains to find Mewtwo. They eventually found it and discovered Dirk had plans of capturing Mewtwo. Together they thwarted his plans, however.
